subject: *: Update client-go and verify all read ts (#58054)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs parent in `pkg/executor`, `pkg/planner`, `pkg/sessionctx`, `pkg/store`: it updates client-go, switches `sessionctx.ValidateSnapshotReadTS` to `oracle.ValidateReadTS` with an explicit `isStaleRead` flag, updates stale-read/snapshot call sites accordingly, and wires the store oracle into copr’s `tikv.NewRegionRequestSender` construction. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness/semantics/consistency/txn/session behavior for the touched areas; later `upstream/master` keeps the same core logic.
